bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible — it is an old Persian saying. Paul does call our affliction light and “but for a moment”.

bibleornot.q: A soft answer turneth away wrath.
bibleornot.x: The verse continues: but grievous words stir up anger.

bibleornot.q: Money is the root of all evil.
bibleornot.x: A misquote. Scripture says “the LOVE of money is the root of all evil”.

bibleornot.q: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
bibleornot.x: Often shortened to “pride goes before a fall”.

bibleornot.q: Spare the rod, spoil the child.
bibleornot.x: These words are from Samuel Butler’s poem Hudibras (1664). Proverbs says, He that spareth his rod hateth his son.

bibleornot.q: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
bibleornot.x: Paul quotes these words of the Lord Jesus to the Ephesian elders.

bibleornot.q: God works in mysterious ways.
bibleornot.x: From William Cowper’s hymn “God moves in a mysterious way”. Isaiah says His ways are higher than ours.

bibleornot.q: Be still, and know that I am God.
bibleornot.x: He adds: I will be exalted among the heathen.

bibleornot.q: To thine own self be true.
bibleornot.x: Shakespeare, in Hamlet. Scripture points us to trust the LORD rather than ourselves.

bibleornot.q: Jesus wept.
bibleornot.x: At the grave of Lazarus — the shortest verse in the English Bible.

bibleornot.q: God will never give you more than you can handle.
bibleornot.x: Not a Bible verse. 1 Corinthians 10:13 is about temptation: God makes a way to escape.

bibleornot.q: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
bibleornot.x: A picture of friends who make each other better.

bibleornot.q: Charity begins at home.
bibleornot.x: An old English proverb. Paul does teach us to provide for our own household.

bibleornot.q: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine.
bibleornot.x: It continues: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

bibleornot.q: Laughter is the best medicine.
bibleornot.x: A popular saying, not Scripture — though Proverbs says a merry heart does good like a medicine.

bibleornot.q: There is no new thing under the sun.
bibleornot.x: The Preacher reflecting on life “under the sun”.

bibleornot.q: The lion shall lie down with the lamb.
bibleornot.x: A common misquote. Isaiah says the WOLF shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard lie down with the kid.

bibleornot.q: Am I my brother’s keeper?
bibleornot.x: Cain’s reply when the LORD asked where Abel was.

bibleornot.q: Hate the sin, love the sinner.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible — the phrase traces to Augustine and Gandhi. God commended His love toward us while we were yet sinners.

bibleornot.q: The truth shall make you free.
bibleornot.x: Jesus said this to those who continued in His word.

bibleornot.q: A penny saved is a penny earned.
bibleornot.x: Attributed to Benjamin Franklin. Proverbs praises the wise who store up rather than spend all.

bibleornot.q: Eat, drink, and be merry.
bibleornot.x: Really in the Bible — said by the rich fool in Jesus’ parable.

bibleornot.q: Love is blind.
bibleornot.x: Chaucer and Shakespeare, not Scripture. Paul says charity suffereth long, and is kind.

bibleornot.q: By their fruits ye shall know them.
bibleornot.x: Jesus’ warning about false prophets.

bibleornot.q: Honesty is the best policy.
bibleornot.x: An English proverb from the 1500s. Scripture says lying lips are abomination to the LORD.

bibleornot.q: O death, where is thy sting?
bibleornot.x: Paul’s shout of victory over the grave.

bibleornot.q: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
bibleornot.x: Attributed to Ambrose of Milan. Paul wrote to Rome: be not conformed to this world.

bibleornot.q: Man shall not live by bread alone.
bibleornot.x: Jesus answered the tempter with words from Deuteronomy.

bibleornot.q: All that glitters is not gold.
bibleornot.x: Shakespeare, The Merchant of Venice. Proverbs says wisdom is better than gold.

bibleornot.q: The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.
bibleornot.x: Job’s worship after losing everything.

bibleornot.q: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
bibleornot.x: Benjamin Franklin’s Poor Richard’s Almanack. Proverbs does ask the sluggard how long he will sleep.

bibleornot.q: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
bibleornot.x: The start of the famous “a time to…” passage.

bibleornot.q: Blood is thicker than water.
bibleornot.x: A proverb, not Scripture. The Bible speaks of a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

bibleornot.q: Be sure your sin will find you out.
bibleornot.x: Moses’ warning to the tribes of Gad and Reuben.

bibleornot.q: Time heals all wounds.
bibleornot.x: A saying from ancient Greece. Scripture says it is God who healeth the broken in heart.

bibleornot.q: Faith without works is dead.
bibleornot.x: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

bibleornot.q: God never closes a door without opening a window.
bibleornot.x: A saying popularised by The Sound of Music. Jesus does say He sets before us an open door no man can shut.

bibleornot.q: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
bibleornot.x: Jesus, the night before the cross.

bibleornot.q: Forgive and forget.
bibleornot.x: Shakespeare’s King Lear. Scripture commands forgiving one another as God forgave us.

bibleornot.q: The wages of sin is death.
bibleornot.x: But the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

bibleornot.q: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
bibleornot.x: Alexander Pope, 1711. Proverbs says the fool rageth and is confident.

bibleornot.q: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
bibleornot.x: David’s song at the dedication of his house.

bibleornot.q: The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
bibleornot.x: A proverb, not Scripture. Jesus said not everyone who says “Lord, Lord” enters the kingdom, but he that doeth the Father’s will.

bibleornot.q: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
bibleornot.x: A much-loved promise to parents.

bibleornot.q: Seeing is believing.
bibleornot.x: A proverb. Jesus said, blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

bibleornot.q: With God all things are possible.
bibleornot.x: Jesus’ answer when the disciples asked who can be saved.

bibleornot.q: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
bibleornot.x: Lao Tzu. Scripture says the steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD.

bibleornot.q: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
bibleornot.x: From the longest chapter in the Bible.

bibleornot.q: Count your blessings.
bibleornot.x: From an 1897 hymn by Johnson Oatman. The psalmist does say, forget not all his benefits.

bibleornot.q: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches.
bibleornot.x: And loving favour rather than silver and gold.

bibleornot.q: Actions speak louder than words.
bibleornot.x: A proverb. John wrote: let us not love in word, but in deed and in truth.

bibleornot.q: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
bibleornot.x: Also found in Psalm 111:10.

bibleornot.q: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
bibleornot.x: The opening of Psalm 19.

bibleornot.q: Everything happens for a reason.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says all things work together for good to them that love God.

bibleornot.q: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
bibleornot.x: David’s prayer of repentance.

bibleornot.q: Follow your heart.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says the heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked.

bibleornot.q: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
bibleornot.x: From Psalm 118.

bibleornot.q: A fool and his money are soon parted.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible — it is from the English poet Thomas Tusser. Proverbs says a foolish man spendeth his treasure up.

bibleornot.q: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
bibleornot.x: The opening of Psalm 27.

bibleornot.q: Good things come to those who wait.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength.

bibleornot.q: The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few.
bibleornot.x: Jesus said this to His disciples.

bibleornot.q: Birds of a feather flock together.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture does warn that evil communications corrupt good manners.

bibleornot.q: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
bibleornot.x: From the Sermon on the Mount.

bibleornot.q: The eyes are the window to the soul.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Jesus said the light of the body is the eye.

bibleornot.q: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
bibleornot.x: One of the Beatitudes.

bibleornot.q: Practice makes perfect.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Paul wrote, Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect.

bibleornot.q: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
bibleornot.x: From the Sermon on the Mount.

bibleornot.q: To err is human, to forgive divine.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible — it is from Alexander Pope. Scripture says to forgive one another, even as God hath forgiven you.

bibleornot.q: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
bibleornot.x: From the Sermon on the Mount.

bibleornot.q: Better late than never.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says, behold, now is the accepted time.

bibleornot.q: I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
bibleornot.x: Jesus’ answer to Thomas.

bibleornot.q: Absence makes the heart grow fonder.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Proverbs says hope deferred maketh the heart sick.

bibleornot.q: The love of money is the root of all evil.
bibleornot.x: Paul to Timothy — the love of money, not money itself.

bibleornot.q: Silence is golden.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Proverbs says even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise.

bibleornot.q: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
bibleornot.x: Paul to the Galatians.

bibleornot.q: Where there’s a will, there’s a way.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Proverbs says a man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

bibleornot.q: If God be for us, who can be against us?
bibleornot.x: Paul to the Romans.

bibleornot.q: Two wrongs don’t make a right.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says, Recompense to no man evil for evil.

bibleornot.q: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
bibleornot.x: Paul to the Philippians.

bibleornot.q: Let go and let God.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says, Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

bibleornot.q: Pray without ceasing.
bibleornot.x: One of the shortest verses in the Bible.

bibleornot.q: Neither a borrower nor a lender be.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible — it is from Shakespeare’s Hamlet. Proverbs says the borrower is servant to the lender.

bibleornot.q: The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
bibleornot.x: Jesus to His disciples in Gethsemane.

bibleornot.q: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

bibleornot.q: A wise son maketh a glad father.
bibleornot.x: The first of the proverbs of Solomon in chapter 10.

bibleornot.q: What goes around comes around.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Proverbs says whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein.

bibleornot.q: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise.
bibleornot.x: Solomon’s advice to the lazy.

bibleornot.q: An eye for an eye makes the whole world blind.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Jesus said, whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

bibleornot.q: Vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
bibleornot.x: The words of the Preacher.

bibleornot.q: Patience is a virtue.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible in those words. Scripture lists longsuffering as part of the fruit of the Spirit.

bibleornot.q: A threefold cord is not quickly broken.
bibleornot.x: From Ecclesiastes, on two being better than one.

bibleornot.q: Every cloud has a silver lining.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Scripture says all things work together for good to them that love God.

bibleornot.q: Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
bibleornot.x: From the letter of James.

bibleornot.q: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Proverbs says a friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

bibleornot.q: He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
bibleornot.x: Jesus to those who accused the woman.

bibleornot.q: Home is where the heart is.
bibleornot.x: Not in the Bible. Jesus said, where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

battle.q: How many days and nights did it rain during the flood?
battle.x: The rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

battle.q: Who was the first king of Israel?
battle.x: Samuel anointed Saul to be captain over the LORD’s inheritance.

battle.q: What did God create on the first day?
battle.x: God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

battle.q: Which sea did Israel cross on dry ground when leaving Egypt?
battle.x: The LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind.

battle.q: How many commandments were written on the tables of stone?
battle.x: He declared His covenant, even ten commandments.

battle.q: Who was thrown into a den of lions?
battle.x: King Darius commanded, and they cast Daniel into the den.

battle.q: Who was the mother of Isaac?
battle.x: Abraham named the son Sarah bore him Isaac.

battle.q: Who interpreted Pharaoh’s dreams of the fat and lean cattle?
battle.x: Joseph said God had shown Pharaoh what He was about to do.

battle.q: Which city’s walls fell after Israel marched around it?
battle.x: The wall fell down flat, and they took the city.

battle.q: Who killed the giant Goliath?
battle.x: David prevailed with a sling and a stone.

battle.q: What did God send for Israel to eat in the wilderness each morning?
battle.x: The house of Israel called its name Manna.

battle.q: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish?
battle.x: The LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah.

battle.q: Which prophet went up to heaven in a whirlwind?
battle.x: Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

battle.q: Who built the first temple in Jerusalem?
battle.x: Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in the fourth year of his reign.

battle.q: What was the name of Ruth’s mother-in-law?
battle.x: Naomi’s sons married Orpah and Ruth, women of Moab.

battle.q: How many sons did Jacob have?
battle.x: Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

battle.q: Who led Israel into the promised land after Moses died?
battle.x: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan.

battle.q: What sign did God give that He would never again flood the whole earth?
battle.x: I do set my bow in the cloud.

battle.q: Which prophetess judged Israel and went to battle with Barak?
battle.x: Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, judged Israel.

battle.q: Who was Moses’ brother?
battle.x: Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother?

battle.q: Who lived nine hundred and sixty-nine years?
battle.x: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years.

battle.q: What is the first book of the Bible?
battle.x: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

battle.q: What did Esau sell to Jacob for bread and pottage of lentiles?
battle.x: He sold his birthright unto Jacob.

battle.q: Which son of King Saul was David’s closest friend?
battle.x: The soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David.

battle.q: Which queen risked her life to save the Jews in Persia?
battle.x: So will I go in unto the king… and if I perish, I perish.

battle.q: Which king had Daniel’s three friends thrown into the fiery furnace?
battle.x: Nebuchadnezzar commanded the furnace be heated seven times more.

battle.q: What did Samson use to slay a thousand Philistines?
battle.x: He found a new jawbone of an ass and slew a thousand men with it.

battle.q: Which prophet told David, “Thou art the man”?
battle.x: Nathan confronted David over Uriah and Bath-sheba.

battle.q: Who was the mother of the prophet Samuel?
battle.x: Hannah called his name Samuel: Because I have asked him of the LORD.

battle.q: In which river did Naaman dip seven times to be healed of leprosy?
battle.x: He dipped himself seven times in Jordan and was clean.

battle.q: Which book contains the words “The LORD is my shepherd”?
battle.x: Psalm 23, a psalm of David.

battle.q: To which city did God send Jonah to preach?
battle.x: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city.

battle.q: Who led the rebuilding of Jerusalem’s wall after the exile?
battle.x: Come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem.

battle.q: What was the name of the garden where Adam and Eve lived?
battle.x: The LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden.

battle.q: What did Aaron’s rod become when he cast it down before Pharaoh?
battle.x: Aaron cast down his rod, and it became a serpent.

battle.q: In which town was Jesus born?
battle.x: Joseph went up to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem.

battle.q: Who baptised Jesus?
battle.x: Jesus came from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

battle.q: How many apostles did Jesus choose?
battle.x: Of His disciples He chose twelve, whom also He named apostles.

battle.q: What was Jesus’ first miracle?
battle.x: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee.

battle.q: Which disciple walked on the water toward Jesus?
battle.x: When Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water.

battle.q: How many days had Lazarus been in the grave when Jesus raised him?
battle.x: Martha said, he hath been dead four days.

battle.q: Who betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver?
battle.x: They covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

battle.q: On which day did Jesus rise from the dead?
battle.x: He rose again the third day according to the scriptures.

battle.q: What is the shortest verse in the English Bible?
battle.x: Two words, at the grave of Lazarus.

battle.q: Who was compelled to carry Jesus’ cross?
battle.x: They compelled one Simon a Cyrenian to bear His cross.

battle.q: In Jesus’ parable, who stopped to help the wounded traveller?
battle.x: A certain Samaritan had compassion on him.

battle.q: What food did Jesus use to feed the five thousand?
o: Seven loaves and a few fishes
battle.x: We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

battle.q: Which Gospel begins, “In the beginning was the Word”?
battle.x: And the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

battle.q: Which Roman governor handed Jesus over to be crucified?
battle.x: When he had scourged Jesus, he delivered Him to be crucified.

battle.q: What did Jesus call the first and great commandment?
o: Love the Lord thy God with all thy heart
Honour thy father and thy mother
battle.x: With all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

battle.q: Who climbed a sycomore tree to see Jesus?
battle.x: He ran before and climbed up into a sycomore tree.

battle.q: How old was Jesus when He stayed behind in the temple among the teachers?
battle.x: When He was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem.

battle.q: How does the first Beatitude begin?
o: Blessed are the poor in spirit
battle.x: For theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

battle.q: Which disciple would not believe until he saw the print of the nails?
battle.x: Except I shall see in His hands the print of the nails… I will not believe.

battle.q: What gifts did the wise men bring to Jesus?
battle.x: They presented unto Him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

battle.q: In which river was Jesus baptised?
battle.x: Jesus was baptized of John in Jordan.

battle.q: How many days did Jesus fast in the wilderness?
battle.x: He fasted forty days and forty nights.

battle.q: On which feast day did the Holy Ghost come upon the believers?
battle.x: When the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

battle.q: Who was the first Christian martyr?
battle.x: They stoned Stephen, calling upon God.

battle.q: By what other name was the apostle Paul known?
battle.x: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost…

battle.q: Saul was travelling to which city when a light from heaven stopped him?
battle.x: As he came near Damascus, suddenly there shined a light from heaven.

battle.q: Which letter lists the fruit of the Spirit?
battle.x: Love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith…

battle.q: According to 1 Corinthians 13, which is the greatest of faith, hope and charity?
battle.x: But the greatest of these is charity.

battle.q: What is the last book of the Bible?
battle.x: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

battle.q: Who received the Revelation on the isle of Patmos?
battle.x: I John… was in the isle that is called Patmos.

battle.q: In Ephesians 6, what is “the sword of the Spirit”?
battle.x: And the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

battle.q: Who was in the Philippian jail with Paul when an earthquake opened the doors?
battle.x: At midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God.

battle.q: Which church received the words, “I can do all things through Christ”?
battle.x: Written in Paul’s letter to the Philippians.

battle.q: Which apostle was shipwrecked on the island of Melita?
battle.x: When they were escaped, they knew that the island was called Melita.

battle.q: “For by grace are ye saved through ___.”
battle.x: And that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.

battle.q: What does James say faith without works is?
battle.x: So faith without works is dead also.

battle.q: Who was chosen to replace Judas among the twelve?
battle.x: The lot fell upon Matthias.

battle.q: Which couple lied about the price of their land and fell down dead?
battle.x: They kept back part of the price and lied to the Holy Ghost.

battle.q: On which day did God rest from all His work?
battle.x: He rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

battle.q: Who was the son born to Adam and Eve after Abel was slain?
battle.x: She bare a son and called his name Seth: for God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel.

battle.q: Which bird returned to Noah with an olive leaf?
battle.x: The dove came in to him in the evening, and in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off.

battle.q: What was Abraham’s name before God changed it?
battle.x: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham.

battle.q: Which nephew of Abram pitched his tent toward Sodom?
battle.x: Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

battle.q: What was the name of the son Hagar bore to Abram?
battle.x: Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

battle.q: Which of Jacob’s sons was sold for twenty pieces of silver?
battle.x: They sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver.

battle.q: What new name did God give to Jacob?
battle.x: Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel.

battle.q: Which son did Rachel bear as she was dying?
battle.x: She called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.

battle.q: Out of what did God call to Moses at Horeb?
battle.x: God called unto him out of the midst of the bush.

battle.q: What was the last plague on Egypt?
battle.x: At midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.

battle.q: On which mountain did the LORD come down to give the law?
battle.x: The LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount.

battle.q: What did Israel make and worship while Moses was on the mount?
battle.x: Aaron fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf.

battle.q: How many years did Israel wander in the wilderness?
battle.x: Your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years.

battle.q: Which two spies urged Israel to go up and possess the land?
battle.x: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh rent their clothes.

battle.q: From which mountain did Moses see the promised land before he died?
battle.x: Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo.

battle.q: Who hid the two spies on the roof of her house in Jericho?
battle.x: She had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax.

battle.q: Which judge defeated Midian with three hundred men?
battle.x: By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you.

battle.q: Because Samson was a Nazarite, what was never to come on his head?
battle.x: No razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God.

battle.q: Whom did Ruth marry in Bethlehem?
battle.x: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife.

battle.q: Who was the father of David?
battle.x: Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

battle.q: Who anointed David in the midst of his brethren?
battle.x: Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren.

battle.q: How many smooth stones did David choose out of the brook?
battle.x: He chose him five smooth stones out of the brook.

battle.q: Which son of David was caught by his head in an oak?
battle.x: His head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth.

battle.q: What did Solomon ask God for at Gibeon?
battle.x: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people.

battle.q: Which queen came to prove Solomon with hard questions?
battle.x: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove him with hard questions.

battle.q: Which birds brought Elijah bread and flesh by the brook Cherith?
battle.x: The ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning and in the evening.

battle.q: On which mount did Elijah gather Israel and the prophets of Baal?
battle.x: Gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal.

battle.q: Who took up the mantle that fell from Elijah?
battle.x: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him.

battle.q: Which king of Judah was eight years old when he began to reign?
battle.x: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign.

battle.q: Which king of Persia proclaimed that the house of God be built at Jerusalem?
battle.x: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia: he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem.

battle.q: Which queen refused to come at King Ahasuerus’ command?
battle.x: The queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment.

battle.q: Who had a gallows fifty cubits high made for Mordecai?
battle.x: The thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

battle.q: In which land did Job live?
battle.x: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job.

battle.q: Which psalm begins, “Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly”?
battle.x: The very first words of the book of Psalms.

battle.q: According to Proverbs 1, what is the beginning of knowledge?
battle.x: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge.

battle.q: Which prophet was set down in a valley full of dry bones?
battle.x: The hand of the LORD set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones.

battle.q: What wrote on the wall at Belshazzar’s feast?
o: The fingers of a man’s hand
battle.x: There came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote upon the plaister of the wall.

battle.q: Which prophet took Gomer to wife?
battle.x: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim.

battle.q: Which prophet said a ruler in Israel would come out of Bethlehem Ephratah?
battle.x: Out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel.

battle.q: What is the last book of the Old Testament?
battle.x: It ends with the promise: I will send you Elijah the prophet.

battle.q: Who walked with God, “and he was not; for God took him”?
battle.x: Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

battle.q: Which tribe was brought near to minister to Aaron the priest?
battle.x: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest.

battle.q: Who entered the ark with Noah, his wife and his three sons?
battle.x: Noah, Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons entered the ark.

battle.q: Who was the mother of John the Baptist?
battle.x: Thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

battle.q: Which angel was sent to a virgin in Nazareth named Mary?
battle.x: The angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth.

battle.q: Into which country did Joseph take the young child and his mother?
battle.x: He took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt.

battle.q: In which city did Jesus dwell as a child, so that He was called a Nazarene?
battle.x: He came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth.

battle.q: What were Peter and Andrew doing when Jesus called them?
o: Casting a net into the sea
Sitting at the receipt of custom
battle.x: They were casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

battle.q: Which disciple was sitting at the receipt of custom when Jesus called him?
battle.x: He saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom.

battle.q: In the Lord’s Prayer, what do we ask to be given this day?
battle.x: Give us this day our daily bread.

battle.q: In Jesus’ parable, upon what did the wise man build his house?
battle.x: A wise man, which built his house upon a rock.

battle.q: How many baskets of fragments were taken up after the five thousand ate?
battle.x: They took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

battle.q: What did Jesus say to the sea when He calmed the storm?
battle.x: He arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still.

battle.q: Which ruler of the synagogue asked Jesus to heal his little daughter?
battle.x: There cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name.

battle.q: Which three disciples did Jesus take up into the high mountain?
battle.x: Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother.

battle.q: Who appeared talking with Jesus when He was transfigured?
battle.x: There appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

battle.q: How often did Jesus tell Peter to forgive his brother?
battle.x: I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

battle.q: In the parable of the talents, how many did the first servant receive?
battle.x: Unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one.

battle.q: Which sister of Martha sat at Jesus’ feet and heard His word?
battle.x: She had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet.

battle.q: In the far country, what was the prodigal son sent into the fields to feed?
battle.x: He sent him into his fields to feed swine.

battle.q: How many lepers were cleansed, of whom only one returned to give thanks?
battle.x: Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

battle.q: To whom did Jesus say, “Ye must be born again”?
battle.x: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

battle.q: By whose well did Jesus sit when He met the woman of Samaria?
battle.x: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus, being wearied, sat thus on the well.

battle.q: Complete Jesus’ words: “I am the good ___.”
battle.x: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

battle.q: Who was the brother of Mary and Martha of Bethany?
battle.x: It was that Mary whose brother Lazarus was sick.

battle.q: On what did Jesus sit as He came into Jerusalem?
battle.x: Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon.

battle.q: To which place did Jesus go with His disciples to pray before His arrest?
battle.x: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane.

battle.q: What was the name of the servant whose ear Peter cut off?
battle.x: He smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

battle.q: Whom did the people ask Pilate to release instead of Jesus?
battle.x: Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

battle.q: What was the place of the crucifixion called?
battle.x: A place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull.

battle.q: Who went to Pilate and begged the body of Jesus?
battle.x: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

battle.q: According to Mark, to whom did the risen Jesus appear first?
battle.x: He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

battle.q: For how many days was Jesus seen by the apostles after His passion?
battle.x: He shewed himself alive after his passion, being seen of them forty days.

battle.q: About how many souls were added after Peter preached at Pentecost?
battle.x: The same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

battle.q: Who put his hands on Saul in Damascus so that he received his sight?
battle.x: Ananias entered into the house, and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul.

battle.q: Whom did Peter raise from the dead at Joppa?
battle.x: Turning him to the body he said, Tabitha, arise.

battle.q: Which centurion at Caesarea sent men to Joppa for Peter?
battle.x: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion.

battle.q: Where were the disciples first called Christians?
battle.x: The disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

battle.q: Which damsel came to the door when Peter knocked after leaving the prison?
battle.x: A damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

battle.q: Whom did the Holy Ghost say to separate with Saul for the work?
battle.x: Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

battle.q: Who was stoned at Lystra and drawn out of the city, supposed dead?
battle.x: Having stoned Paul, they drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

battle.q: Which seller of purple heard Paul at Philippi and was baptized?
battle.x: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, whose heart the Lord opened.

battle.q: In which city did Paul find an altar inscribed “TO THE UNKNOWN GOD”?
battle.x: I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD.

battle.q: What was Paul’s craft, which he shared with Aquila and Priscilla?
battle.x: By their occupation they were tentmakers.

battle.q: Which young man fell from the third loft while Paul was long preaching?
battle.x: There sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus.

battle.q: Which king said to Paul, “Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian”?
battle.x: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

battle.q: “For all have sinned, and come short of the ___ of God.”
battle.x: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God.

battle.q: According to Romans 6, what is the gift of God?
battle.x: The gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

battle.q: In 1 Corinthians 12, to what does Paul liken Christ and His people?
battle.x: As the body is one, and hath many members, so also is Christ.

battle.q: In the armour of God, what is the shield?
battle.x: Above all, taking the shield of faith.

battle.q: In the armour of God, what is the helmet?
battle.x: Take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit.

battle.q: “At the name of Jesus every ___ should bow.”
battle.x: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow.

battle.q: To whom did Paul write, “Let no man despise thy youth”?
battle.x: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers.

battle.q: “All scripture is given by ___ of God.”
battle.x: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine.

battle.q: For whom did Paul plead in his letter to Philemon?
battle.x: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds.

battle.q: “Now faith is the substance of things ___.”
battle.x: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

battle.q: According to James, which little member “boasteth great things”?
battle.x: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things.

battle.q: Complete 1 John 4:8: “for God is ___.”
battle.x: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

battle.q: To how many churches in Asia was John told to send what he saw?
battle.x: Send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia.

battle.q: In Revelation 21, what shall God wipe away from their eyes?
battle.x: God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

wordle.hint: How we are saved
wordle.x: For by grace are ye saved through faith.

wordle.hint: The substance of things hoped for
wordle.x: Faith is the evidence of things not seen.

wordle.hint: New every morning
wordle.x: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed.

wordle.hint: The heavens declare it
wordle.x: The heavens declare the glory of God.

wordle.hint: Jesus leaves it with us
wordle.x: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.

wordle.hint: Take it up daily
wordle.x: Let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

wordle.hint: He shall save His people from their sins
wordle.x: Thou shalt call his name JESUS.

wordle.hint: He led Israel out of Egypt
wordle.x: God sent him to Pharaoh.

wordle.hint: Shepherd, psalmist and king
wordle.x: Samuel anointed him in the midst of his brethren.

wordle.hint: He walked on the water
wordle.x: He walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

wordle.hint: Three days in a great fish
wordle.x: The LORD prepared a great fish.

wordle.hint: Bringer of good tidings of great joy
wordle.x: The angel said unto them, Fear not.

wordle.hint: Noah built one after the flood
wordle.x: Noah builded an altar unto the LORD.

wordle.hint: Jesus is the ___ of life
wordle.x: I am the bread of life.

wordle.hint: Jesus is the ___ of the world
wordle.x: I am the light of the world.

wordle.hint: The way, the ___, and the life
wordle.x: I am the way, the truth, and the life.

wordle.hint: They hear His voice
wordle.x: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them.

wordle.hint: What David put in his sling
wordle.x: He took a stone, and slang it.

wordle.hint: The word of God is the ___ of the Spirit
wordle.x: The sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

wordle.hint: Jesus offers the living kind
wordle.x: A well of water springing up into everlasting life.

wordle.hint: God so loved it
wordle.x: For God so loved the world.

wordle.hint: The LORD ___ thee, and keep thee
wordle.x: The priestly blessing.

wordle.hint: A ___ of life for those who endure
wordle.x: He shall receive the crown of life.

wordle.hint: They mount up with wings like this bird
wordle.x: They shall mount up with wings as eagles.

wordle.hint: Love, joy and peace are the ___ of the Spirit
wordle.x: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace…

wordle.hint: Keep it with all diligence
wordle.x: For out of it are the issues of life.

wordle.hint: What happens by grace through faith
wordle.x: For by grace are ye saved.

wordle.hint: As for me and my house, we will ___ the LORD
wordle.x: Choose you this day whom ye will serve.

wordle.hint: ___ in the LORD with all thine heart
wordle.x: And lean not unto thine own understanding.

wordle.hint: The sheep know the shepherd’s
wordle.x: The sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

wordle.hint: The son of promise
wordle.x: Abraham called his son Isaac.

wordle.hint: He was renamed Israel
wordle.x: Thy name shall be called no more Jacob.

wordle.hint: She laughed at the promise of a son
wordle.x: Sarah laughed within herself.

wordle.hint: Bread from heaven
wordle.x: Israel called the name thereof Manna.

wordle.hint: The land Israel left behind
wordle.x: The hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

wordle.hint: The bird that fed Elijah
wordle.x: The ravens brought him bread and flesh.

wordle.hint: Paul had one in the flesh
wordle.x: There was given to me a thorn in the flesh.

wordle.hint: Built at Babel
wordle.x: Let us build us a city and a tower.

wordle.hint: Under His ___ shalt thou trust
wordle.x: He shall cover thee with his feathers.

wordle.hint: Faith without these is dead
wordle.x: Faith without works is dead also.

wordle.hint: A sacred song — there are 150
wordle.x: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD.

wordle.hint: A tenth brought into the storehouse
wordle.x: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse.

wordle.hint: Abraham’s name at first
wordle.x: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country.

wordle.hint: Brother of Moses
wordle.x: Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother?

wordle.hint: The prophet who took Gomer to wife
wordle.x: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri.

wordle.hint: Son of Zebedee, brother of John
wordle.x: He saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother.

wordle.hint: The name of the fisherman called Peter
wordle.x: Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother.

wordle.hint: Paul called him his own son after the common faith
wordle.x: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith.

wordle.hint: Jacob called this son a lion’s whelp
wordle.x: Judah is a lion’s whelp.

wordle.hint: Mother-in-law of Ruth
wordle.x: Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house.

wordle.hint: The mount where the LORD came down
wordle.x: The LORD came down upon mount Sinai.

wordle.hint: He betrayed the Son of man with a kiss
wordle.x: Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

wordle.hint: What the LORD shall do to the world in righteousness
wordle.x: He shall judge the world in righteousness.

wordle.hint: Shepherds kept watch over it by night
wordle.x: Shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

wordle.hint: Jesus told Peter to feed them
wordle.x: He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

wordle.hint: The leaf the dove brought back to Noah
wordle.x: In her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off.

wordle.hint: The good land flowed with milk and this
wordle.x: A land flowing with milk and honey.

wordle.hint: The passover was one, kept every year
wordle.x: His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

wordle.hint: Prepared before me in the presence of mine enemies
wordle.x: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies.

wordle.hint: With the rod, it comforts me
wordle.x: Thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

wordle.hint: It went out of Eden to water the garden
wordle.x: A river went out of Eden to water the garden.

wordle.hint: It was forty days upon the earth
wordle.x: The flood was forty days upon the earth.

wordle.hint: Created with the heaven in the beginning
wordle.x: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

wordle.hint: What God called the darkness
wordle.x: God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night.

wordle.hint: How many times Naaman dipped in Jordan
wordle.x: He dipped himself seven times in Jordan.

wordle.hint: Days and nights Jonah was in the fish
wordle.x: Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

wordle.hint: Days and nights of rain upon the earth
wordle.x: The rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

wordle.hint: How we are to seek the kingdom of God
wordle.x: Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness.

wordle.hint: Without shedding of it is no remission
wordle.x: Without shedding of blood is no remission.

wordle.hint: The disciples said, Lord, ___ us to pray
wordle.x: Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

wordle.hint: Do this and pray, that ye enter not into temptation
wordle.x: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.

wordle.hint: Samuel said this, for thy servant heareth
wordle.x: Speak; for thy servant heareth.

wordle.hint: An enemy sowed tares among it
wordle.x: His enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat.

wordle.hint: Some fell by the way side when the sower sowed
wordle.x: Some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up.

wordle.hint: A merchant sold all that he had for one of great price
wordle.x: When he had found one pearl of great price, he sold all that he had, and bought it.

wordle.hint: Paul asked, where is thy victory?
wordle.x: O grave, where is thy victory?

wordle.hint: He is not here: for he is ___
wordle.x: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said.

wordle.hint: It received Jesus out of their sight
wordle.x: A cloud received him out of their sight.

wordle.hint: How good it is for brethren to dwell together in it
wordle.x: How good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

wordle.hint: So is that people, whose God is the LORD
wordle.x: Happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

wordle.hint: God shall wipe them all away
wordle.x: God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

wordle.hint: What I will do in the house of the LORD for ever
wordle.x: I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

wordle.hint: Arise, and do this; for thy light is come
wordle.x: Arise, shine; for thy light is come.

wordle.hint: Made of the rib taken from the man
wordle.x: The rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman.

wordle.hint: Train one up in the way he should go
wordle.x: Train up a child in the way he should go.

wordle.hint: Paul told Timothy to let no man despise his
wordle.x: Let no man despise thy youth.

wordle.hint: Resist him, and he will flee from you
wordle.x: Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

wordle.hint: The clean cloth Joseph wrapped the body of Jesus in
wordle.x: He wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.

wordle.hint: Thomas wanted to see their print in His hands
wordle.x: Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, I will not believe.
